title: Flow registry
description: Schema for data/index.yaml — the registry that drives the left navigator (order, group headers, sub-flow nesting). Parsed by backend/flow_store.py (_load_index / _registry_entries / _collect_ids). Lenient: unknown keys are allowed.

flows.description: Primary registry. Each entry maps to data/<id>.flow.mmd + <id>.cards.yaml.

order.description: Fallback registry used only when `flows` is absent: a flat list of flow ids.

entry.description: A registry entry: either a bare flow-id string, or an object.

group.description: Optional navigator section header. Entries sharing a group (or all with no group) are bucketed together in order.

name.description: Optional navigator label, used ONLY as a fallback when the flow file is missing/unparsed; otherwise flow.name from the cards file wins.

children.description: Optional nested sub-flows, rendered indented under the parent. Recursive — same entry shape, walked to arbitrary depth. Pair with `subflow:` on the parent node's card to enable drill-down.
